buckets.description_es: Business expansion and demand momentum (organic vs acquired).
Profitability (gross/EBITDA/operating/net) and drivers (pricing, mix, SG&A, R&D).
ROIC/ROE/ROA, asset turnover, and efficiency ratios (incl. bank efficiency ratio).
Debt, liquidity, interest coverage, maturity profile, and capital strength (incl. bank/REIT/insurer specifics).
CFO/FCF, cash-flow quality, capex intensity, working capital, and capital allocation.
Multiples (P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/FCF, P/B, etc.) relative to growth and quality.
Non-accounting KPIs (combined ratio, MLR, occupancy, load factor, etc.).
Risk flags (goodwill, dilution, inventory issues, concentration, cyclicality, etc.).

combined_ratio.note: P&C: <95 excellent, 95–100 good/OK, >100 underwriting loses money.

loss_ratio.note: Line-specific; use as a rough guide.

medical_loss_ratio.note: MLR is often regulated/stable; compare vs guidance and peers.

net_interest_margin.note: Depends on mix (deposits) and the rate environment.

loan_to_deposit.note: Too high can strain liquidity; too low may indicate under-utilization.

occupancy_rate.note: Varies by REIT type; use as a rough guide.

leverage_ratio_reit.note: Net debt / EBITDA (or proxy); depends on asset quality and debt duration.

ffo.note: Valorar crecimiento de FFO/AFFO por acción y payout.

affo.note: AFFO is closer to dividend-paying capacity.

load_factor.note: Depends on network; watch trend and seasonality.

casm_ex_fuel.note: Compare against peers; depends on fleet, labor, and network.

rasm.note: Compare against peers; depends on routes/mix.

reserve_replacement_ratio.note: >100% replaces reserves; watch M&A vs organic.

all_in_sustaining_cost.note: AISC is mine/country-dependent; compare peers and trend.

commodity_cash_cost.note: Compare against the commodity cost curve.

reserve_life.note: Long reserve life provides visibility; strategy-dependent.

ore_grade.note: Very specific; compare with peers of the same commodity.

gross_retention.note: High GRR = low churn; compare within the segment.

rule_of_40.note: Growth + FCF margin; common SaaS heuristic.

arr.note: Watch ARR growth and recurring % (if available).

same_store_sales.note: Compare vs inflation and traffic; adjust for calendar effects.

inventory_shrink.note: Impacts margin; varies by format and region.

gross_margin.note: Highly mix-dependent (fabless vs foundry vs equipment).

inventory_turnover.note: Signals the cycle; watch the trend.
